hints.title: Greedy Leaf Reduction
hints.text: To minimize the cumulative sum of non-leaf products, smaller leaves should be eliminated earlier with their smallest immediate neighbor.

hints.title: Monotonic Order Invariant
hints.text: Maintain elements in decreasing order. When encountering a value larger than the top element, pop the smaller element and multiply it by the minimum of its adjacent neighbors.

hints.title: Drain Remaining Decreasing Sequence
hints.text: After processing the entire array, pop remaining elements from smallest to largest and multiply each by the remaining adjacent element.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Interval dynamic programming takes cubic O(N^3) time, which is unnecessarily slow for leaf combination.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A monotonic decreasing collection identifies the optimal adjacent multiplier in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that smaller leaves should be combined with min(left_neighbor, right_neighbor) as early as possible.
complexity.notes: Every leaf reduction adds min(left, right) * current to the total.
